$comment: Auto-detection splits every sword into TWO leaves (blade+guard, then the pommel, with a gutter above it), so these two are hand-placed and merge each sword's halves. Only the two sword kinds the game actually has are kept: gladius (one-handed) and greatsword (two-handed). The leftmost sword starts at x=0 and is clipped by the sheet edge, so it was skipped.
